configurationFields.label: Server Public Status
configurationFields.description: Sets whether the server is local or public and, if public, whether it is included on the server list or is invite-only

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as shown on the server list

configurationFields.label: Client Name
configurationFields.description: Name that the server uses in-game (for example, for chat messages)

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for clients to connect to the server. Empty = no password (default)

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password that clients of the [admin interface](https://github.com/OpenTTD/OpenTTD/blob/master/docs/admin_network.md) need to use it. Empty = no password (default), meaning the admin interface is disabled

configurationFields.label: Autosave Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval between automatic game saves

configurationFields.label: Autosave On Exit
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will autosave on exit

configurationFields.label: Save Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the savename of a game to load on server start. Both saved games and scenarios can be loaded. If no game savename is specified, a new game is started. If desired, set this value to "config/save/autosave/exit.sav" to load the default autosave after the server has started and autosaved once

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Minimum Active Players
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of active players, below which the server will be automatically paused

configurationFields.label: Maximum Companies
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of companies on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Admin Chat
configurationFields.description: Enables admin chat on the server

configurationFields.label: Maximum Join Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum amount of time allowed for a client to join the server. Increasing this can help clients with slower download speeds to join servers with larger maps

configurationFields.label: Allow Inflation
configurationFields.description: If set, inflation will be enabled in the economy, where costs rise slightly faster than payments

configurationFields.label: Maximum Initial Loan
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum initial amount a company can loan (in GBP), in multiples of £50,000. If the Server Currency is different, the amount will be converted at the relevant exchange rate. The maximum loan amount will increase over time if Inflation is enabled

configurationFields.label: Initial Interest Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the initial interest rate charged on loans for a new map

configurationFields.label: Subsidy Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the bonus multiplier for subsidies offered in-game (assuming they are not disabled)

configurationFields.label: Subsidy Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of years for which subsidies are awarded. 0 = subsidies disabled

configurationFields.label: Infrastructure Maintenance
configurationFields.description: If enabled, infrastructure causes maintenance costs. The cost grows in proportion to the network size, thus affecting larger companie more than smaller ones

configurationFields.label: Running Costs
configurationFields.description: Sets the level of maintenance and running costs of vehicles and infrastructure

configurationFields.label: Construction Costs
configurationFields.description: Sets the level of construction and purchase costs

configurationFields.label: Allow Disasters
configurationFields.description: If enabled, disasters can occur on a new map, which may occasionally block or destroy vehicles or infrastructure

configurationFields.label: Allow Economic Recessions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, economic recessions can occur on new maps every few years. During recessions, all production is significantly lower

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Breakdown Frequency
configurationFields.description: Sets the frequency at which inadequately serviced vehicles break down

configurationFields.label: Aircraft Crash Probability
configurationFields.description: Sets the probability of aircraft crashes

configurationFields.label: Local Authority Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets how far in tiles an object has to be from a town centre before it comes under the local authority jurisdiction

configurationFields.label: Town Council Tolerance
configurationFields.description: Sets how much noise and environmental damage by companies affect their town rating and therefore further construction activity in the area

configurationFields.label: Town Population Noise Level Increase - Lenient
configurationFields.description: If Town Council Tolerance is lenient, then the town noise limit will increase from the default for every specified number of inhabitants

configurationFields.label: Town Population Noise Level Increase - Tolerant
configurationFields.description: If Town Council Tolerance is tolerant, then the town noise limit will increase from the default for every specified number of inhabitants

configurationFields.label: Town Population Noise Level Increase - Hostile
configurationFields.description: If Town Council Tolerance is hostile, then the town noise limit will increase from the default for every specified number of inhabitants

configurationFields.label: Town Population Noise Level Increase - Permissive
configurationFields.description: If Town Council Tolerance is permissive, then the town noise limit will increase from the default for every specified number of inhabitants

configurationFields.label: Allow Bribes
configurationFields.description: If enabled, companies can try to bribe local authorities to increase their rating. If noticed by an inspector, the company will not be able to act in the town for six months

configurationFields.label: Allow Exclusive Rights
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows buying of exclusive transport rights in the area of a local authority. Opponents' stations (passenger and cargo) will not receive any cargo for a whole year

configurationFields.label: Allow Funding Of Roads
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows companies to give money to towns to fund road reconstruction, in order to sabotage road-based services in the town

configurationFields.label: Allow Funding Of Buildings
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows companies to give money to towns to fund new houses

configurationFields.label: Enable Airport Noise Level
configurationFields.description: If disabled, there can only be two airports in each town. If enabled, the number of airports is limited instead by the noise acceptance of the town, which depends on population, airport size and distance

configurationFields.label: Town Growth Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed of town growth

configurationFields.label: Allow Town Roads
configurationFields.description: If enabled, towns are allowed to build roads. Otherwise, players must build roads for a town to grow

configurationFields.label: Allow Town Level Crossings
configurationFields.description: If enabled, towns are allowed to build level crossings

configurationFields.label: Remove Useless Road Elements
configurationFields.description: If enabled, towns will remove useless road elements during construction to clean up dead-ends

configurationFields.label: Allow Founding Of Towns
configurationFields.description: Sets whether towns can be founded by players during the game and, if so, whether they will use the road layout used by other towns in the game, or can have a custom layout

configurationFields.label: Town Cargo Production Scale
configurationFields.description: Scales the cargo production of towns by the set percentage. Minimum OpenTTD v14.0

configurationFields.label: Industry Production Scale
configurationFields.description: Scales the cargo production of industries by the set percentage. Minimum OpenTTD v14.0

configurationFields.label: Town Cargo Generation Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets how much cargo is produced by houses in towns, relative to the overall town population

configurationFields.label: Enable Demand-Only Cargo Generation
configurationFields.description: If set, cargo will only be generated at a station when a vehicle with the capacity to pick up that cargo has visited. Affects station ratings

configurationFields.label: Allow Multiple Industries Per Town
configurationFields.description: If enabled, two or more industries of the same type can be built on land that comes under the jurisdiction of one town. Normally only one of each type is allowed

configurationFields.label: Oil Refinery Limit
configurationFields.description: Oil refineries are only constructed near the map border (the coast for island maps). This sets the maximum allowed distance (in an even number of tiles) from the edge of the map for refineries

configurationFields.label: Allow Serving Neutral Industries
configurationFields.description: If enabled, industries with attached stations may also be served by company-owned stations built nearby. Otherwise, they can only be served by their own attached stations

configurationFields.label: Modified Catchment Areas
configurationFields.description: If enabled, catchment areas will be differently sized for different types of stations and airports, and as a result be more realistic. For example, train stations have a larger catchment area than bus stations and airport catchment areas are bigger still

configurationFields.label: Enable Improved Loading
configurationFields.description: If set, only one vehicle is loaded at a time until full, before loading the next vehicle. When disabled, all vehicles in a station are loaded simultaneously, possibly needlessly blocking multiple platforms

configurationFields.label: Enable Gradual Loading
configurationFields.description: If set, vehicles will load cargo over a period of time, not full load instantly

configurationFields.label: Timekeeping Units
configurationFields.description: Sets the timekeeping units of the game. Calendar = classic OpenTTD, with year of 12 months. Wallclock = clock-based time, with cargo production and financials based on one-minute increments, about equal to a month in Calendar mode. Minimum OpenTTD v14.0

configurationFields.label: Minutes Per Year
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of minutes in a calendar year for Wallclock timekeeping units. 0 = stop calendar time from changing. Minimum OpenTTD v14.0

configurationFields.label: Recalculation Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time taken for each recalculation of a link graph component. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Recalculation Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between subsequent recalculations of the link graph. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Distribution Mode For Passengers
configurationFields.description: Sets the passenger distribution mode. "Manual" = no auto distribution, "Asymmetric" = arbitrary number in either direction between stations, "Symmetric" = roughly same number in each direction. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Distribution Mode For Mail
configurationFields.description: Sets the mail distribution mode. "Manual" = no auto distribution, "Asymmetric" = arbitrary amount in either direction between stations, "Symmetric" = roughly same amount in each direction. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Distribution Mode For ARMOURED Cargo
configurationFields.description: Sets the ARMOURED cargo distribution mode. "Manual" = no auto distribution, "Asymmetric" = arbitrary amount in either direction between stations, "Symmetric" = roughly same amount in each direction. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Distribution Mode For Other Cargo
configurationFields.description: Sets the distribution mode for other cargo. "Manual" = no auto distribution, "Asymmetric" = arbitrary amount in either direction between stations, "Symmetric" = roughly same amount in each direction. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Distribution Accuracy
configurationFields.description: Sets the accuracy of distribution. Higher values will increase CPU time for the link graph calculation. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Effect Of Distance On Demand
configurationFields.description: If set higher than 0, the distance between stations will affect how much cargo is sent - the higher the value, the less cargo is sent far away. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Symmetric Mode Returning Cargo
configurationFields.description: If set to less than 100%, the symmetric distribution will behave more like the asymmetric one, and less cargo will be forcibly sent back than received. 0% = symmetric distribution behaves like asymmetric distribution. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: Saturation Limit
configurationFields.description: Where there are multiple paths between two stations, the shortest path will be saturated to the set limit first, then the second shortest path, and so on. Saturation is estimated from capacity and planned usage. Use increments of 5%. Only affects new games

configurationFields.label: AI Competitors
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of AI competitors to be created on the server

configurationFields.label: Competitor Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed at which the AI competitors will build (assuming AI competitors are not disabled)

configurationFields.label: Allow Giving Of Money
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows transfer of money between companies

configurationFields.label: Allow Buying Of Shares
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows buying and selling of company shares. Shares will only be available for companies reaching a certain age

configurationFields.label: Minimum Age For Buying Shares
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum age of a company for others to be able to buy and sell shares from them

configurationFields.label: Train Acceleration Model
configurationFields.description: Sets the physics model for train acceleration. "Original" penalises slopes equally for all vehicles. "Realistic" penalises slopes depending on various properties, like length and tractive effort

configurationFields.label: Train Slope Steepness
configurationFields.description: Sets the steepness of slopes for trains. Higher values make it more difficult to climb a hill. It only applies if the Realistic acceleration model is selected

configurationFields.label: Enable Wagon Speed Limits
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the speed limits of wagons (if any) are also used to determine the maximum speed of a train

configurationFields.label: Freight Trains Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the impact of carrying freight in trains. The weight of freight trains is multiplied by this multiplier to simulate very heavy trains for more realism

configurationFields.label: Road Vehicle Acceleration Model
configurationFields.description: Sets the physics model for road vehicle acceleration. "Original" penalises slopes equally for all vehicles. "Realistic" penalises slopes depending on various properties of the engine, like tractive effort

configurationFields.label: Road Vehicle Slope Steepness
configurationFields.description: Sets the steepness of slopes for road vehicles. Higher values make it more difficult to climb a hill. It only applies if the Realistic acceleration model is selected

configurationFields.label: Aircraft Speed Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the relative speed of aircraft compared to other vehicle types, to reduce the amount of income of transport by aircraft

configurationFields.label: Disallow Train Reversing
configurationFields.description: If enabled, trains can reverse at the end of line only, and not at non-terminus stations, even if there is a shorter path to their next destination when reversing

configurationFields.label: Disable Servicing If No Breakdowns
configurationFields.description: If set, and vehicle breakdowns are disabled, vehicles will not go to depots or hangars for servicing

configurationFields.label: Enable Helicopter Servicing
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a helicopter landing on a heliport or helipad will automatically be serviced

configurationFields.label: Enable Dynamic Engines
configurationFields.description: If enabled, multiple NewGRF vehicle sets will be able to exist side-by-side

configurationFields.label: Extend Vehicle Life
configurationFields.description: Extends every vehicle's life by the number of years specified

configurationFields.label: Enable Service Interval Percentage
configurationFields.description: If enabled, servicing of vehicles will be triggered by reliability dropping to a certain percentage of the maximum reliability, rather than by the time passed since the last service

configurationFields.label: Train Service Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the default service interval for new trains, if no explicit service interval is set for the vehicle. Increment by 15 from minimum 30

configurationFields.label: Road Vehicle Service Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the default service interval for new road vehicles, if no explicit service interval is set for the vehicle. Increment by 15 from minimum 30

configurationFields.label: Ship Service Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the default service interval for new ships, if no explicit service interval is set for the vehicle. Increment by 15 from minimum 30

configurationFields.label: Aircraft Service Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the default service interval for new aircraft, if no explicit service interval is set for the vehicle. Increment by 15 from minimum 40

configurationFields.label: Disable Airport Expiry
configurationFields.description: If set, each airport type will stay available forever after its introduction

configurationFields.label: Disable Vehicle Expiry
configurationFields.description: If set, each vehicle model will stay available forever after its introduction

configurationFields.label: Maximum Trains
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of trains that a company can have

configurationFields.label: Maximum Road Vehicles
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of road vehicles that a company can have

configurationFields.label: Maximum Aircraft
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of aircraft that a company can have

configurationFields.label: Maximum Ships
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of ships that a company can have

configurationFields.label: Maximum Train Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum length of a train

configurationFields.label: Station Spread
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum area that parts of a station may be spread out over. High values will slow the game

configurationFields.label: Allow Building Adjacent Stations
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows building a station directly adjacent to another one to create a new station instead of merging the new tile(s) with the existing station

configurationFields.label: Allow Joining Distant Stations
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players building a new station have the option of merging it with an existing station within the catchment area or creating a new station

configurationFields.label: Disable Electric Tracks Requirement
configurationFields.description: If set, tracks will not be required to be electrified to enable electric engines to run on them

configurationFields.label: Map Size - X Axis
configurationFields.description: Sets the size of the map's X axis (in tiles)

configurationFields.label: Map Size - Y Axis
configurationFields.description: Sets the size of the map's Y axis (in tiles)

configurationFields.label: Landscape
configurationFields.description: Sets the landscape for the server, which determines basic gameplay scenarios with different cargoes and town growth requirements

configurationFields.label: Land Generation System
configurationFields.description: Sets the land generation system for the server. The Original generator depends on the base graphics set, and composes fixed landscape shapes. TerraGeneris is a Perlin noise-based generator with finer control settings

configurationFields.label: Terrain Type (TGP Only)
configurationFields.description: Sets the terrain type (hilliness of the landscape) for generating a new map

configurationFields.label: Terrain Smoothness (TGP Only)
configurationFields.description: Sets the smoothness of the map, ie the frequency of hills

configurationFields.label: Variety Distribution (TGP Only)
configurationFields.description: Sets the extent to which the map should contain mountainous areas in addition to flat areas

configurationFields.label: Snow Coverage
configurationFields.description: Sets the approximate amount of snow on the sub-arctic landscape. Snow affects industry generation and town growth requirements. Land just above sea level is always without snow

configurationFields.label: Snow Line Height
configurationFields.description: Sets the altitude (in tiles) at which snow starts in sub-arctic landscapes. Snow affects industry generation and town growth requirements

configurationFields.label: Desert Coverage
configurationFields.description: Sets the approximate amount of desert on the tropical landscape. Desert affects industry generation

configurationFields.label: Sea Level (TGP Only)
configurationFields.description: Sets the sea level, and as a result the size of the area covered by seas and lakes on a new map. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Sea Level must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Sea Level
configurationFields.description: If "Custom" is selected for Sea Level, sets roughly the percentage area covered by seas and lakes on a new map

configurationFields.label: Quantity Of Rivers
configurationFields.description: Sets how many rivers are generated

configurationFields.label: Minimum River Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum length (in tiles) of rivers

configurationFields.label: Tree Placing
configurationFields.description: Sets how trees are distributed on the map. Original = uniformly scattered. Improved = planted in groups

configurationFields.label: Town Quantity
configurationFields.description: Sets the quantity of towns created on a new map. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Town Quantity must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Town Quantity
configurationFields.description: If "Custom" is selected for Town Quantity, sets the exact number of towns to be created on a new map

configurationFields.label: Larger Towns Proportion
configurationFields.description: Sets the proportion of towns that will grow to become cities. For example, if 4 is specified, 1 in 4 (25%) will become cities. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Initial City Size Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the average initial size of cities relative to towns

configurationFields.label: Industry Density
configurationFields.description: Sets how many industries should be generated and what level should be maintained during the game

configurationFields.label: Town Layout
configurationFields.description: Sets the layout for the road network of towns

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Driving Side
configurationFields.description: Sets which side of the road vehicles drive on

configurationFields.label: Starting Year
configurationFields.description: Sets the starting year for the game. 1925 appears to be the earliest year

configurationFields.label: Restart Year
configurationFields.description: Sets the year when the server will restart automatically (on 1 January). 0 = no automatic restart

configurationFields.label: Town Name Nationality
configurationFields.description: Sets the nationality that town names are sourced from in randomly generated games. If Other is selected, Custom Town Name Nationality must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Town Name Nationality
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom NewGRF source for random town names, if "Other" is selected under Town Name Nationality. The NewGRF file must be installed in the newgrf directory

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the server branch to install. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!
